Subject: Discovery follow-up: rolling regional deep-dive schedule

Hi Maya — great conversation today. Quick recap and a proposed approach to make sure each regional engineering group can attend live without burning evenings repeatedly.

Recap: Avery Labs is evaluating inference performance and cost tradeoffs for production workloads. Key asks: throughput targets, recommended batching profiles, quantization impact, and reliable observability for cost attribution. You mentioned EU product and APAC infra leads will want to join the technical deep dive.

Pilot proposal (concise):
- Format: 60-minute technical sessions, weekly for 6 weeks.
- Rotation: rolling 3-week pattern so each session favors one region: Week U (US), Week E (EU), Week A (APAC), then repeat.

Candidate start times (local times noted):
- Tue Jul 15 — 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT / 17:00 BST (US-priority)
- Tue Jul 22 — 14:00 BST / 09:00 EDT / 23:00 HKT (EU-priority)
- Tue Jul 29 — 07:00 HKT / 23:00 BST (Mon) / 16:00 PDT (APAC-priority)

If preferred, I can convert these to a shareable matrix with local-time columns and two rotation templates (3-week rolling or 2-week mirror). Ben — attaching our standard matrix for reference.

Action: Maya, please confirm attendees (names + emails) and whether Tuesdays/Wednesdays are ok (you mentioned Thursdays are tight). If these slots don’t work, send two preferred windows per region and we’ll generate the locked schedule.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
